# surya-ocr-2.5

*Model · Surya OCR 2.5 · AI Pubs Open RAIL-M License (Modified)*

Surya OCR 2.5 is Datalab's page OCR model: one 689M-parameter vision-language model (Qwen3.5-style architecture)
that does layout and OCR in one pass, run through Datalab's `surya-ocr` package (its full-page path, with a block
mode for pages whose full-page answer fails). The card reports 91 languages on an internal benchmark and lists no
fixed set. License: the card front matter says `openrail`; the weights are under a modified OpenRAIL-M license (the
"AI Pubs Open RAIL-M License (Modified)", copied as `upstream/00c843e9cae45611dca0a6dc2c9bbbf2dadaaed3/LICENSE`):
free for research and personal use, and for organizations below USD 5,000,000 of revenue and of funding; not for
use by anyone offering a product or service that competes with Datalab's; other commercial use needs a separate
license. The code (the `surya-ocr` package) is Apache-2.0.
The upstream card is in `upstream/00c843e9cae45611dca0a6dc2c9bbbf2dadaaed3/README.md`.
